summary: Franco-Nevada filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q3 2026 results news release, MD&A and interim financial statements for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. Q3 revenue was $549.3 million (+13%) on 130,435 GEOs sold (-6%), with operating cash flow of $429.2 million, net income of $395.5 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $493.9 million; management noted tracking toward mid-range FY guidance. The company reported $4.8 billion available capital and no debt. This is a routine quarterly earnings filing, not a special situation; watch royalty/stream deal deployment and Cobre Panama negotiations.
